title: Return normalized iid hard-sphere outputs while paying the time-dependent lineage cost
status_authority: Completed working derivation supplied with original proof; no substantive completed review of this new result is claimed.
reported_status: Completed working derivation supplied with original proof; no substantive completed review of this new result is claimed.
scientific_scope_status: The completed working construction uses conserved currency h(v)=a+|v|^2 and g_t=h f_t/(a+e0). A recursive rate-dependent collision lineage samples the actual partner, accepts the physical collision rate under an explicit local clock and selects an outgoing particle proportional to h. Final acceptance a/h returns weight-one f_t output with mean proposal count (a+e0)/a. The proof supplies almost-sure termination and a finite expected full-tree cost with an exponential-in-time bound.
